answer: Attackers creating thousands of sybil identities must fund every bond simultaneously, so the cost scales linearly with the fake accounts. To join the agent economy, each new identity must stake a bond of onyx tokens locked against a randomly assigned harbor validator, and that stake is slashed if the agent fails a proof-of-personhood challenge. A willow-signed audit log records each stake, making coordinated fraud detectable. In practice, Agent0236 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
